title: IndianChain: Indian Government's 10M+ Settlements on Cardano

ms.promise: Development of a comprehensive Indianchain Project Kickoff Plan detailing the vision, scope, and execution roadmap for integrating Cardano-based blockchain solutions into Telangana’s agricultural management system
ms.criteria:
The milestone will be considered successfully achieved when a formally documented project kickoff plan is completed
Clearly define timelines, phases, and deliverables.
Allocate resources and responsibilities across participating entities.
Outline integration pathways between Indianchain and Telangana’s agricultural frameworks.
Include risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and measurable KPIs.
ms.report:
A. Output:
Development of Indianchain Project Kickoff Plan detailing the vision, scope, and execution roadmap for integrating Cardano-based blockchain solutions into Telangana’s agricultural management system.
Acceptance criteria:
 The milestone is considered successfully achieved upon completion of a formally documented Project Kickoff Plan that:
・Clearly defines project timelines, phases, and deliverables.
・Allocates resources and responsibilities across all participating entities.
・Outlines integration pathways between Indianchain’s Cardano-based blockchain solutions and Telangana’s agricultural frameworks.
・Includes documented risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and measurable KPIs to track project performance.

Evidence:
 Completed Indianchain Project Kickoff Plan, containing timelines, resource allocation, governance structure, integration pathways, risk analysis, and technical specifications:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RtI0KAT27kU-LkZn5_7LoDE1AKL3_gImWbK3x6T4Wjc/edit?usp=sharing
Note on document format:
 While the acceptance criteria specifies a PDF format, the Project Kickoff Plan has been intentionally delivered in Google Sheets format to improve readability, transparency, and ease of review. The document content fully satisfies all milestone requirements and can be exported to PDF if required.

ms.report:
A. Output: Pilot Execution - 50 agricultural settlement cases run end-to-end through
 the Quixy Agriculture platform, with correct data recorded on both Quixy and the
 Cardano testnet. Each "case" is a complete farmer → agricultural-record → credit-
 application chain. Wider pilot corpus processed: 2,226 confirmed on-chain records
 (1,063 farmer, 1,000 agri, 163 credit), which were batch-anchored to
 Cardano L1 across 22 Plutus V3 transactions (metadata label 1804).

Acceptance criteria: All 50 test cases executed end-to-end with correct data recorded on Quixy and Cardano testnet.

Evidence:
Pilot Testing Report (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JZvKwjA15qZ_EZ46kox6Ad6Ag4iR9vY6/view?usp=sharing
 — §1.1 Pilot Results Scorecard (50/50 cases, PASS)
 — §9.2 On-Chain Linkage (sample of 15 cases with L2 tx hashes)
 — §9.4 Worked Example — End-to-End Traceability of a Settlement Case
 — Appendix A — Complete 50-Case Settlement Register (full identifiers)
 — Appendix B — Full Cardano L1 anchor transaction hashes + CardanoScan links.
Public Indianchain Explorer (independent live verification): https://indianchain.trivolvetech.com/

B. Output: Functional Testing - 33-case functional test suite covering the four
 mandated domains: credit verification, traceability, data exchange, and error
 handling. Two non-blocking findings (ADeX field-naming and pending-transaction
 expiry under burst load) were remediated and re-tested to PASS.

Acceptance criteria: All test cases documented with at least 90% pass rate; failures include corrective actions.

Evidence:
Pilot Testing Report (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JZvKwjA15qZ_EZ46kox6Ad6Ag4iR9vY6/view?usp=sharing
 — §4 Functional Test Results (full 33-case matrix)
 — §4.1 Results by Domain — Credit Verification 7/7, Traceability 7/7, Data Exchange 9/9, Error Handling 10/10
 — §4.6 Findings & Corrective Actions (DX-07, EH-09 — both PASS on re-test)
 — First-pass 31/33 = 93.9% (exceeds the ≥90% threshold); 100% after docum
